_note: Phrase data for src/main/voice-lint.mjs (T-31-YOKI step 2.1). Our own EN/VI/ZH lists, written for this app; matched case-insensitively on whole words (no word boundary for Chinese). helpDesk = call-centre closers and offers; sermon = moralising or reminding the user; disclaimer = 'as an AI' and apology boilerplate. Lists are small on purpose: a phrase is added only after it shows up in a real reply (step 2.2 baseline). Review 21-11: removed the short sermon phrases that hit plain statements (zh 要记住/请记住, en 'you should always'); add moralising forms back only when a real reply shows them.
